title: Cyber Monday 2026 — US e-commerce peak day (collides with AWS re:Invent day 1)
source: EST: derived by weekday arithmetic from a rule this calendar already carries an independent instance of. Cyber Monday is by universal trade convention the Monday after Thanksgiving; Thanksgiving is the FOURTH THURSDAY of November (5 U.S.C. 6103), which in 2026 is 2026-11-26. The tracked entry thanksgiving-half-day-2026-11-27 corroborates that anchor from inside this repo without circularity — a 13:00 ET early close on the Friday only exists if Thanksgiving is the Thursday before it — so the Monday after is 2026-11-30. Secondary corroboration NEWS: awarenessdays.com calendar lists 'Cyber Monday 2026 is Monday 30 November 2026' (searched 2026-09-09). Filed estimate on three counts: no `IR:`/`CENSUS:` primary publishes a 'Cyber Monday' date because it is a marketing convention rather than a scheduled release; the datable ARTIFACT here is Adobe Analytics' recap, whose publication time is a vendor decision with no published calendar (2025's landed the following morning); and this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep. Discovered 2026-09-09
notes: PROPOSED BY THE aws-reinvent-2026 LANE because the two events are the same calendar day, and that collision is the finding rather than the trivia. re:Invent 2026 opens Monday 2026-11-30 (confirmed, IR: aws.amazon.com/events/reinvent, re-verified direct 2026-09-09) — which is also Cyber Monday, AMZN's single largest retail day. AMZN is the only symbol in this calendar whose two independent narratives, cloud and retail, land a headline on one date, and neither event's research was aware of the other. Adobe Analytics is the standing measurement of the retail side (2025: a record $14.25B of US online spend on Cyber Monday, $44.2B across the Thanksgiving weekend; its 2026 season forecast crossed $250B online, +5.3% y/y — news.adobe.com, searched 2026-09-09), published as a recap the following morning rather than intraday, so the print is a next-day read and not a same-session catalyst. WHY IT MATTERS TO THE PROPOSER and not only to a retail lane: the aws-reinvent-2026 ledger's live stance is that the keynote is a narrative amplifier rather than a repricing catalyst, and the cleanest way that stance fails is CONFOUNDING — an AMZN move on 11-30 or 12-01 attributed to a keynote that was actually a consumer print, or the reverse. Registering the collision in advance is what makes the two separable at close-out. NAMED LIMIT: this is a convention, not a scheduled release, and it licenses nothing on its own — S1 is killed on AMZN (p=0.6854, multi-symbol-sweep.md) and an estimate-labelled date may only widen caution. CONSIDERED AND DECLINED alongside it so the absences read as decisions: Black Friday 2026-11-27, because the calendar already tracks that session as thanksgiving-half-day-2026-11-27 and a second entry on the same date would double-count one shortened session; and the Mastercard SpendingPulse holiday recap, whose 2026 publication date could not be pinned to any primary this session.
